The apex predator
Developed by the legendary motorsports arm of Nissan, the Z® NISMO® rattles the cages of the
competition with a tuned 420-hp engine,1 enhanced 9-speed automatic transmission, and unique
Sport+ Drive Mode for incredible response.
Aerodynamics learned at the track make their way to the street. A unique honeycomb grille enhances
engine cooling, while front canard wing vortex generators, wider sill side spoilers, rear air splitters,
and a unique rear spoiler all help provide additional downforce.
Putting power to the pavement is a NISMO-tuned suspension featuring larger-diameter shocks and
higher spring rates, massive Akebono® brakes with larger 15" rotors, and wider 19" lightweight RAYS®
forged-alloy wheels wrapped in special Dunlop® tires.
Inside is as beautiful as it is focused with Recaro® seats, an Alcantara®-wrapped steering wheel with
a red leather stripe at 12 o’clock, and a unique instrument display on the digital dash.
